verdict.rationale: Bento's marketing says every release is scored against production history offline, in CI, and on live traffic, which addresses offline evaluation grounded in production traces. Nothing documents curating named or reusable datasets from those traces. Issue grouping and signal backfills are adjacent features, not dataset curation. missing for 10: explicit dataset curation or selection from traces, documentation of how offline eval runs are configured and executed, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them

citations.quote: Every release scored against your production history — offline, in CI, and on live traffic.
